description: Field medic - gadgets and bots that keep the party alive.
_source_note: Rebuilt from CoA Build Hub screenshots (Sept 2026): 13 confirmed Invention nodes trimmed to a lean 12-node tree per Kyle's bloat direction. Build: ZIGGI-6K confirmed via tooltip as a real healing-bot summon ('the latest in regenerative technology, to aid you in healing allies until dismissed') - kept as the capstone since this matches Kyle's own played experience (Healing Tinkerer). Stubbed as a strong party-wide HoT rather than a full pet entity since the pet system doesn't exist yet - revisit once it does.

nodes.name: Scientific Nature
nodes.description: Increases healing done by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Bandage Gun
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of Repair Shot by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Self-Sustaining Tech
nodes.description: Increases maximum Mana by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Rejuvenating Gadgetry
nodes.description: Increases Repair Shot healing by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Healing Radiator
nodes.description: Learn Healing Radiator, deploying a small device that heals the whole party for a moderate amount over several turns.

nodes.name: Cybernetic Revival
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Defibrillate by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: Fixed during DPS niche audit (Oct 2026): keyed to ability_tinker_defibrillate_cooldown, but no Defibrillate ability ever existed in data/abilities/tinker.json - built it as a real revive-type ability (see tinker_defibrillate's own _source note). Also fixed the stored value's sign: was -1, which INCREASES cooldown under talented_cooldown's formula (cooldown - reduction) instead of reducing it as the description says - same sign-flip bug found on 4 other talents in this sweep.

nodes.name: Combat Symbiosis
nodes.description: Increases your armor by 3% per rank while a party member is below 50% health.

nodes.name: Nanobot Swarm
nodes.description: Learn Nanobot Swarm, releasing nanobots that heal the lowest-health ally over time.

nodes.name: Nanobot Cleanser
nodes.description: Learn Nanobot Cleanser, removing a harmful Poison or Disease effect from an ally.

nodes.name: Nanobot Reconstruction
nodes.description: Learn Nanobot Reconstruction. Send Nanobots to an ally, healing them for 600 over 1 min. Can only be sent to 1 target at a time and cannot be dispelled.
nodes._source: Real screenshot: Requires Level 16, Nanobot Reconstruction (Rank 1) - real self-rank gate, Kyle-confirmed.

nodes.name: Stim Rounds
nodes.description: Learn Stim Rounds. Load Stim Rounds, causing Repair Shot to also heal the 2 lowest-HP party members for 30% of the amount healed.

nodes.name: Med Pack
nodes.description: Learn Med Pack. Toss a med pack to an ally, healing for 354 over 6 sec and cleanses all bleed, poison and disease effects.
nodes._source: Real screenshot: Requires Level 26, Med Pack (Rank 1) - real self-rank gate, Kyle-confirmed.

nodes.name: Build: Battery Reclaimer
nodes.description: Learn Battery Reclaimer, a device that restores mana to the party over several turns.

nodes.name: Zap!
nodes.description: Learn Zap! Fires a long range zap of electricity that heals an ally for 332. Scales with modifiers to Repair Shot.
nodes._source: Real screenshot: Requires Level 38, Zap! (Rank 1) - real self-rank gate, Kyle-confirmed.

nodes.name: Build: Restorative Field
nodes.description: Increases Repair Shot's healing by 10% while Battery Reclaimer is active.

nodes.name: My Greatest Invention
nodes.description: Learn My Greatest Invention, instantly healing your entire party for a massive amount.
nodes._source: Kyle: 'basically an end game talent unlock... on par with shit like wild growth or circle of healing', 'unlocks around lvl 50 (in talent tree - so near the very bottom)'. Placed at tier 5 rather than displacing the tree's real screenshot-confirmed tier-6 capstone (Build: ZIGGI-6K, 'matches Kyle's own Healing Tinkerer experience'). Previously modeled as a passive Nanobot Swarm/Healing Radiator healing-boost at tier 3 - real correction, it's a standalone AoE heal ability.

nodes.name: Build: ZIGGI-6K
nodes.description: Deploy ZIGGI-6K, a regenerative healing bot that heals the party each turn until dismissed.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Teaches you Build: ZIGGI-6K, the latest in regenerative technology, to aid you in healing allies until dismissed.' The Invention capstone - matches Kyle's own Healing Tinkerer experience.

nodes.name: Field Medicine
nodes.description: Increases healing done by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Stabilizing Agents
nodes.description: Increases maximum Mana by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Triage Protocol
nodes.description: Increases healing done to targets below 35% health by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Efficient Dosing
nodes.description: Reduces Mana cost of Repair Shot by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Field Repair
nodes.description: Increases Armor of the target of your heals by 2% per rank for 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Rocket Launcher
nodes.description: Learn Rocket Launcher, a heavy single-target Fire nuke.
nodes._source: Real screenshot: Rocket Launcher's real requirement text reads 'Invention (1)' despite the ability's own Demolition-adjacent Fire-nuke flavor - real cross-tree case, Kyle-confirmed. Moved here from tinker_demolition.json where it previously (incorrectly) lived.

nodes.name: Gadgeteer
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Build: abilities by 5% per rank.

nodes.name: Antitoxin Coating
nodes.description: Increases resistance to Poison and Disease by 5% per rank.

nodes.name: Battery Efficiency
nodes.description: Increases mana regeneration by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Surge Protector
nodes.description: Increases healing done by 3% per rank while above 80% Mana.
